# Stack Overflow

> > The world's largest Q&A platform for developers with 24M+ programming questions across JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, and hundreds of other technologies.

Stack Overflow is the primary community-driven knowledge base for programmers, featuring AI-assisted search, technology-specific Collectives (AWS, Azure, PHP), and comprehensive help resources. The platform uses a voting system to surface the best answers and maintains strict quality guidelines for questions and answers.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Python
- Java
- C#
- AI Assist
- Angular
- AWS
- .NET
- PHP
- Android
- jQuery
- Question Assistant
- Collectives
- Meta Stack Overflow
- Stack Exchange

## Getting Started

- [Stack Overflow - Where Developers Learn, Share, & Build Careers](https://stackoverflow.com/HomePage): Homepage with AI Assist chat, personalized question feed, and community Q&A
- [Newest Questions - Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com): Main Q&A feed showing 24M+ newest programming questions across all topics
- [Tour - Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/tour): Introduction tour explaining how Stack Overflow Q&A and voting works
- [How do I use tags to find topics I'm interested in? - Help Center](https://stackoverflow.com/help/interesting-topics): Guide to using tags, filters, and RSS feeds for topic discovery

## Asking and Answering Questions

- [How do I ask a good question? - Help Center](https://stackoverflow.com/help/how-to-ask): Guide to writing quality questions with on-topic guidelines and examples
- [How do I write a good answer? - Help Center](https://stackoverflow.com/help/how-to-answer): Best practices for writing quality, helpful answers to questions
- [What should I do when someone answers my question? - Help Center](https://stackoverflow.com/help/someone-answers): Guide for voting and accepting answers to your questions
- [What topics can I ask about here? - Help Center](https://stackoverflow.com/help/on-topic): Guidelines defining acceptable programming questions and on-topic content
- [Asking - Help Center](https://stackoverflow.com/help/asking): Index of question-asking guidelines, closure, deletion, and duplicates

## Technology Topics and Communities

- [Newest 'python' Questions - Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/python): Python tag page with 2.2M+ questions filtered by topic and activity
- [Introducing Collectives™: Communities within Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/collectives): Technology-focused communities like Azure, PHP, R Language, and AWS
- [Mobile Development Collective - Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/collectives/mobile-dev): Mobile dev community for iOS/Android with 2.1M questions and articles
- [AI Assist - Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/ai-assist): AI-powered search with MCP Server and ProLLM benchmarks for developers

## Learning Resources and Guides

- [Git for beginners: The definitive practical guide](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/315911/git-for-beginners-the-definitive-practical-guide): Comprehensive Git beginner's guide with setup, workflow, and references
- [The Definitive C Book Guide and List](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/562303/the-definitive-c-book-guide-and-list): Community-curated list of quality C programming books by skill level
- [A Beginners' Guide to Learning JavaScript?](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/2970314/a-beginners-guide-to-learning-javascript): JavaScript learning resources including tutorials and interactive guides
- [MVVM: Tutorial from start to finish?](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/1405739/mvvm-tutorial-from-start-to-finish): WPF MVVM tutorial recommendations from beginner to advanced level
- [Learning to write a compiler](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/1669/learning-to-write-a-compiler): Educational compiler construction resources for C/C++, Java, and Ruby

## Help and Support

- [Help Center - Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/help): Comprehensive help center with FAQ, posting guidelines, and site policies
- [Meta Stack Overflow](https://meta.stackoverflow.com): Meta site for discussing Stack Overflow bugs, features, and site feedback
- [Help Center - Contact Us](https://stackoverflow.com/contact): Contact page for account issues, DMCA notices, and support requests

- [Best Companies Hiring Developers - Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/jobs/companies): Browse companies hiring developers with tech stack filters and profiles

- [How to do overlay onboarding, walkthrough, product guided tour in Angular](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/63313381/how-to-do-overlay-onboarding-walkthrough-product-guided-tour-in-angular): Angular guided tour libraries comparison for mobile/desktop onboarding
- [Guides/Tutorials on unobtrusive javascript/ajax](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/3323586/guides-tutorials-on-unobtrusive-javascript-ajax): Unobtrusive JavaScript and AJAX tutorial recommendations with jQuery
- [Pdf.js basic guide/tutorial to build a viewer with zoom pan and scroll](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/42630540/pdf-js-basic-guide-tutorial-to-build-a-viewer-with-zoom-pan-and-scroll): PDF.js viewer implementation guide with zoom, pan, and scroll features
